title: A partnership around your music
description: Compare Silver, Gold and Platinum partnerships with Artanrecords: release support, responsibilities, master ownership and agreement-based financial terms.

nextSteps.title: Find the right partnership
nextSteps.text: You do not need to choose a tier before introducing your music. Share your project and what you need; we will review it and discuss a suitable scope with you.

principles.title: Your work. A considered next step.
principles.text: Silver, Gold and Platinum describe our involvement, not the quality of your music. Choose a preference or ask us to recommend a partnership. We review the project, our capacity and the scope before offering an agreement.

principles.title: What zero upfront means
principles.text: Accepted standard releases carry no upfront base distribution fee. You provide finished release-ready masters, artwork, metadata, credits, contributor information and the necessary rights and clearances. Additional services and expenses must be agreed in advance as included, artist-paid or recoupable. Nothing is added silently.

principles.title: Your masters remain yours
principles.text: Our partnership model leaves master ownership with the artist. The agreement defines the licence, term, territory and share of eligible recording-side Net Receipts. Publishing, songwriting, live income, merchandise and unrelated recordings are separate unless expressly agreed.

principles.title: From introduction to agreement
principles.text: A preference is not acceptance or an automatic contract. After review, we may propose the requested partnership, recommend another scope or decline. Services, revenue allocation, approved expenses, reporting and departure arrangements are confirmed before onboarding.

items.name: Silver
items.description: For artists with finished music who want a considered, professionally administered release.

sections.title: Take care of the release
sections.text: The agreed base scope covers onboarding, scheduling, metadata and contributor review, artist-profile mapping, artwork and master technical checks, explicit-content classification and identifier administration where applicable. We coordinate delivery through our distribution infrastructure and monitor the result. Acceptance by every listening service is not guaranteed.

sections.title: A lasting catalogue presence
sections.text: Approved artists and releases receive catalogue pages with biography, artwork, credits, release information, listening links and public artist links. This is a place within the Artanrecords catalogue, not a standalone artist website. Basic corrections, release maintenance and contractually appropriate takedown administration are part of the agreed release relationship.

sections.title: Clear records and practical guidance
sections.text: A release checklist, preparation guidance, agreed recording-income allocation and available reporting support the work. Studio access, agreement visibility and online statements will be introduced only when their secure services are operational; no live financial dashboard is promised today.

sections.title: What is separate
sections.text: Paid advertising, PR, custom artwork, mastering, videos, domains, standalone websites, advances and publishing administration are not automatic inclusions. Promotion, playlists, streams, earnings and acceptance are never guaranteed.

items.name: Gold
items.description: For artists who want help shaping how a release is positioned, presented and developed.

sections.title: Build the release together
sections.text: Gold adds a defined release plan to the Silver base: positioning, timing, lead times, sequencing, release narrative, biography review, profile readiness, an asset checklist and a post-release review. The agreed plan identifies deliverables and responsibilities rather than promising an unlimited service.

sections.title: Preparation with purpose
sections.text: The marketing scope can include an audience assessment, organic campaign plan, announcement copy, content guidance, link strategy and pitch preparation. Legitimate DSP pitching is available only where the project and mechanism are eligible. Label-owned channel consideration does not guarantee publication or placement; paid media and external PR are separately agreed.

sections.title: A home beyond the release
sections.text: Gold artists are eligible for a scoped standalone website covering biography, discography, listening links and contact or press information, with responsive and accessible presentation. Eligibility is not unlimited custom development. Domain ownership, funding, renewal, hosting, maintenance and handover are agreed before work begins.

sections.title: Understand what comes next
sections.text: Priority coordination and a review of available release performance help inform the next step. We interpret only data we actually receive; geographic, playlist or audience information is not promised where unavailable. Studio analytics remain dependent on an operational backend.

items.name: Platinum
items.description: For selected projects where Artanrecords takes a deeper role in release leadership, presentation and artist development.

sections.title: A deeper role in the work
sections.text: Platinum builds on Gold with an agreed label-led project plan, release-calendar coordination, campaign management, catalogue strategy and periodic artist-development reviews. Multi-release planning and higher-touch involvement must have a defined scope and realistic capacity. Requesting Platinum does not grant it automatically.

sections.title: One considered presentation
sections.text: The project may include expanded artwork direction, visual positioning, campaign narrative, editorial development and website creative direction. A dedicated website receives priority within the agreed scope, including press material, release archives and a defined handover. Third-party production is not automatically included.

sections.title: Investment with clear terms
sections.text: Custom campaign strategy is distinct from paid media spend. Any external investment must be agreed as label-funded and non-recoupable, artist-paid, or an approved capped recoupable expense. No advertising budget, advance, press coverage or commercial outcome is automatic.

sections.title: A continuing conversation
sections.text: Scheduled strategic reviews can cover positioning, future releases, audience development and relevant introductions. Sync, brand, live and licensing opportunities receive consideration only where available, with separate rights and terms where needed. The artist retains creative independence. Deeper Studio reporting is a future capability, not a current financial service.

questions.title: Can you recommend a partnership?
questions.text: Yes. Share your music and what you want to build. We can recommend a scope after reviewing the project. No preference creates an entitlement or agreement.

questions.title: How is recording income shared?
questions.text: The written offer explains the artist and Artanrecords shares of contractually defined eligible master-side Net Receipts, including any approved deductions and expenses. Review those terms before signing. Partnership names never override a signed agreement.

questions.title: What happens when the agreement ends?
questions.text: The agreement must define notice, licence expiry, final reporting, outstanding amounts, catalogue changes and any website or domain handover. Distribution migration needs coordination; continuity of service data or playlists cannot be guaranteed.

questions.title: Are marketing results guaranteed?
questions.text: No. Pitching, promotion and opportunity consideration cannot guarantee streams, editorial placement, press, growth or earnings. Publishing and other rights administration require separate terms.
